question: What exhaustive understanding of the eightfold divisions is sought by the practitioner?
premises: The subject is the division into groups of eight times eight
The aim is complete knowledge of this division
The scope of knowing is described as without end
inference: The practitioner seeks to know fully and exhaustively the division of the eight groups of eight
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight-times-eight division is not specified in this verse
plain_english: I seek to know fully and without end the division of the eight groups of eight.
